changeSet.author: Batool_Bushra
changeSet.sql: DROP VIEW IF EXISTS reports.vwbillingchargeline;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS reports.vwbillingcharge;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS reports.vwbillingchargeresponsibility;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS reports.vwbillingreservation;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS reports.vwbillingallocation;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS reports.vwbillingledger;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS reports.vwbillingdebittransaction;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS reports.vwbillingpricingsnapshot;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingchargeline AS SELECT bcl.id, bcl.charge_id, bcl.patient_service_product_id, bcl.patient_id, bcl.encounter_id, bcl.billing_item_type, bcl.brand_medication_id, bcl.diagnostic_test_id, bcl.service_id, bcl.procedure_id, bcl.item_code, bcl.item_description, bcl.service_source, bcl.source_id, bcl.quantity, bcl.unit_price, bcl.gross_amount, bcl.discount_amount, bcl.exemption_amount, bcl.tax_amount, bcl.net_amount, bcl.patient_responsibility_amount, bcl.insurance_responsibility_amount, bcl.other_payer_responsibility_amount, bcl.allocated_amount, bcl.outstanding_amount, bcl.reserved_amount, bcl.currency, bcl.status, bcl.current_pricing_snapshot_id, bcl.patient_insurance_id, bcl.pre_authorization_required, bcl.pre_authorization_status, bcl.pre_authorization_request_id, bcl.pre_authorization_reference_no, bcl.reversed_charge_line_id, bcl.idempotency_key, bcl.cancelled_date, bcl.cancelled_by, bcl.cancellation_reason, bcl.notes, bcl.created_by, bcl.created_date, bcl.last_modified_by, bcl.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_charge_line bcl;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingchargeline TO report_user;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingcharge AS SELECT bc.id, bc.charge_number, bc.patient_id, bc.encounter_id, bc.charge_type, bc.currency, bc.gross_amount, bc.discount_amount, bc.exemption_amount, bc.tax_amount, bc.net_amount, bc.allocated_amount, bc.outstanding_amount, bc.line_count, bc.status, bc.charge_date, bc.confirmed_date, bc.closed_date, bc.cancelled_date, bc.cancelled_by, bc.cancellation_reason, bc.reversed_charge_id, bc.idempotency_key, bc.source_type, bc.source_id, bc.source_reference, bc.notes, bc.created_by, bc.created_date, bc.last_modified_by, bc.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_charge bc;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingcharge TO report_user;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingchargeresponsibility AS SELECT bcr.id, bcr.charge_id, bcr.charge_line_id, bcr.patient_service_product_id, bcr.patient_id, bcr.encounter_id, bcr.responsible_party_type, bcr.responsibility_role, bcr.payer_id, bcr.patient_insurance_id, bcr.policy_number, bcr.member_number, bcr.responsibility_amount, bcr.allocated_amount, bcr.outstanding_amount, bcr.coverage_percentage, bcr.deductible_amount, bcr.copay_amount, bcr.coinsurance_amount, bcr.non_covered_amount, bcr.contractual_adjustment_amount, bcr.currency, bcr.status, bcr.pre_authorization_required, bcr.pre_authorization_status, bcr.pre_authorization_reference_no, bcr.claim_id, bcr.claim_reference, bcr.superseded_responsibility_id, bcr.adjustment_reason, bcr.effective_date, bcr.closed_date, bcr.idempotency_key, bcr.created_by, bcr.created_date, bcr.last_modified_by, bcr.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_charge_responsibility bcr;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingchargeresponsibility TO report_user;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingreservation AS SELECT br.id, br.reservation_number, br.wallet_id, br.payment_id, br.payment_transaction_id, br.patient_id, br.encounter_id, br.charge_id, br.charge_line_id, br.charge_responsibility_id, br.patient_service_product_id, br.original_reserved_amount, br.remaining_reserved_amount, br.consumed_amount, br.released_amount, br.currency, br.status, br.reserved_date, br.consumed_date, br.released_date, br.cancelled_date, br.release_reason, br.release_notes, br.released_by, br.cancelled_by, br.cancellation_reason, br.previous_reservation_id, br.idempotency_key, br.transaction_group_id, br.created_by, br.created_date, br.last_modified_by, br.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_reservation br;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingreservation TO report_user;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingallocation AS SELECT ba.id, ba.allocation_number, ba.charge_id, ba.charge_line_id, ba.charge_responsibility_id, ba.patient_service_product_id, ba.patient_id, ba.encounter_id, ba.allocation_source_type, ba.reservation_id, ba.payment_id, ba.payment_transaction_id, ba.debit_transaction_id, ba.source_reference_type, ba.source_reference_id, ba.source_reference_number, ba.allocated_amount, ba.remaining_allocated_amount, ba.reversed_amount, ba.currency, ba.status, ba.allocation_date, ba.reversed_date, ba.reversed_by, ba.reversal_reason, ba.original_allocation_id, ba.idempotency_key, ba.transaction_group_id, ba.notes, ba.created_by, ba.created_date, ba.last_modified_by, ba.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_allocation ba;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingallocation TO report_user;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingledger AS SELECT bl.id, bl.ledger_number, bl.transaction_group_id, bl.correlation_id, bl.idempotency_key, bl.patient_id, bl.encounter_id, bl.wallet_id, bl.payment_id, bl.payment_transaction_id, bl.charge_id, bl.charge_line_id, bl.charge_responsibility_id, bl.reservation_id, bl.allocation_id, bl.debit_account_id, bl.debit_transaction_id, bl.refund_id, bl.transaction_type, bl.ledger_scope, bl.amount, bl.currency, bl.available_change, bl.reserved_change, bl.consumed_change, bl.refunded_change, bl.debit_balance_change, bl.allocated_change, bl.outstanding_change, bl.wallet_available_before, bl.wallet_available_after, bl.wallet_reserved_before, bl.wallet_reserved_after, bl.debit_balance_before, bl.debit_balance_after, bl.responsibility_outstanding_before, bl.responsibility_outstanding_after, bl.entry_direction, bl.entry_category, bl.reversed_ledger_id, bl.reference_type, bl.reference_id, bl.reference_number, bl.description, bl.reason, bl.transaction_date, bl.source_channel, bl.created_by, bl.created_date, bl.last_modified_by, bl.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_ledger bl;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingledger TO report_user;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingdebittransaction AS SELECT bdt.id, bdt.transaction_number, bdt.debit_account_id, bdt.patient_id, bdt.encounter_id, bdt.charge_responsibility_id, bdt.charge_id, bdt.charge_line_id, bdt.patient_service_product_id, bdt.payment_id, bdt.payment_transaction_id, bdt.parent_transaction_id, bdt.transaction_type, bdt.amount, bdt.currency, bdt.balance_before, bdt.balance_after, bdt.status, bdt.transaction_date, bdt.due_date, bdt.settled_date, bdt.reference_type, bdt.reference_id, bdt.reference_number, bdt.reason, bdt.approved_by, bdt.approved_date, bdt.idempotency_key, bdt.transaction_group_id, bdt.notes, bdt.created_by, bdt.created_date, bdt.last_modified_by, bdt.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_debit_transaction bdt;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingdebittransaction TO report_user;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingpricingsnapshot AS SELECT bps.id, bps.charge_line_id, bps.patient_service_product_id, bps.patient_id, bps.encounter_id, bps.price_list_id, bps.price_list_item_id, bps.billing_configuration_id, bps.discount_id, bps.tax_id, bps.pricing_source, bps.pricing_version, bps.price_list_code, bps.price_list_name, bps.price_list_item_code, bps.quantity, bps.base_unit_price, bps.gross_amount, bps.discount_type, bps.discount_rate, bps.discount_amount, bps.discount_reason, bps.discount_approved_by, bps.exemption_type, bps.exemption_rate, bps.exemption_amount, bps.exemption_reason, bps.tax_type, bps.tax_rate, bps.taxable_amount, bps.tax_amount, bps.net_amount, bps.currency, bps.calculation_order, bps.rounding_mode, bps.rounding_scale, bps.patient_responsibility_amount, bps.insurance_responsibility_amount, bps.other_payer_responsibility_amount, bps.calculation_payload, bps.status, bps.effective_date, bps.superseded_date, bps.superseded_by_snapshot_id, bps.pricing_reason, bps.override_reason, bps.idempotency_key, bps.created_by, bps.created_date, bps.price_source, bps.setup_source_id, bps.last_modified_by, bps.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_pricing_snapshot bps;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingpricingsnapshot TO report_user;
